ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Strongly skewed toward low-intensity pixels (black) across approximately 95% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) contrast limited to localized surface disruptions and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Ventral surface consists of a single contiguous low-intensity dark gray to black field; high-intensity pixels are distributed in fine linear streaks across the center-right lobe and in dense, high-contrast clusters at the extreme distal points of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression at the fluke center with a vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees; depth relative to the lobe peaks is approximately 1/4 of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; amplitude of serration peaks is greatest on the left lobe and distal right lobe, characterized by jagged, non-uniform pixel variations against the sea background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature from the median notch extending to the tips, terminating in sharp, accreted distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast pixel formations (white and beige) located at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct white linear streaks; notable diagonal rake-like marks on the mid-to-lower section of the right lobe and horizontal scratches on the medial left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the tips; visible white linear abrasions (rake marks) concentrated on the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Brownish-orange organic protrusions (likely algae or bio-fouling) adhering to the high-intensity barnacle clusters at the tips.
